content_sections.heading: AEES Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The AEES Recruitment 2026 notice confirms 22 November 2026 as the last date for submitting online applications. Detailed information on educational qualifications, age limits, relaxation, application procedures, application fees and selection criteria is scheduled to be made available on the recruitment portal on 2 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: AEES Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: AEES has announced 254 vacancies for Principal, Vice-Principal, PGT, TGT, Librarian, PRT and Balvatika Teacher positions. The largest number of vacancies is available for Trained Graduate Teachers, with 102 posts, followed by Primary Teachers with 99 posts across the general and Music categories. The notification also identifies vacancies under Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) categories. These are included within the notified vacancies and will be adjusted against the respective reservation categories. AEES states that the vacancy numbers are tentative and may increase or decrease. content_sections.heading: AEES PGT Vacancy 2026 - Subject-wise Details
content_sections.text: AEES has announced 27 Post Graduate Teacher vacancies across nine subjects, including English, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Computer Science, Commerce, Economics and History.

content_sections.heading: AEES TGT Vacancy 2026 - Subject-wise Details
content_sections.text: The Trained Graduate Teacher category accounts for 102 vacancies. The highest number is in Mathematics-Physics, with 22 posts, followed by English with 14 posts. Chemistry-Biology and Computer Science each have 13 vacancies.

content_sections.heading: AEES Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Atomic Energy Education Society has issued Recruitment Notification 01/2026 for 254 vacancies covering Principal, Vice-Principal, PGT, TGT, Librarian, PRT and Balvatika Teacher positions. The preliminary notification includes post-wise vacancies, subject-wise distribution, category-wise reservation and important application information. Detailed recruitment instructions are scheduled to be made available on 2 November 2026 through the official online application portal. content_sections.heading: AEES Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the post-wise educational qualifications, experience requirements and other eligibility conditions prescribed by AEES. The preliminary notification does not provide a complete qualification table for individual posts. According to the notice, detailed information covering educational qualifications, professional experience, age limits, relaxation rules and other general requirements will be available on the AEES application portal from 2 November 2026. Applicants should verify the requirements for their selected post and subject from the detailed instructions before submitting the online application.

content_sections.heading: AEES Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The preliminary AEES Recruitment 2026 notice does not specify the minimum or maximum age limits for Principal, Vice-Principal, PGT, TGT, Librarian, PRT or Balvatika Teacher posts. The detailed age criteria and applicable relaxations are expected to be published with the recruitment instructions on 2 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: AEES Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Detailed pay and allowance conditions for all posts should be checked in the complete recruitment instructions.

content_sections.heading: AEES Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The preliminary AEES notification does not specify the application fee or category-wise exemptions. These details are scheduled to be released on the AEES online application portal on 2 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: AEES Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: AEES will publish the post-wise selection procedure, examination requirements and other recruitment conditions through its online application portal. The preliminary notice confirms the vacancies but does not provide the complete examination pattern, syllabus or selection-stage details. Candidates should refer to the detailed recruitment instructions for information regarding the selection process applicable to their respective posts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AEES Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit their applications through the official AEES online recruitment portal. The last date for application submission is 22 November 2026. Applicants should read the detailed instructions when they become available before completing the form. Visit aees.onlineregistrationforms.com . Open the AEES Recruitment Notification 01/2026. Read the post-wise eligibility criteria and application instructions. Select the relevant post and subject. Complete the registration and enter the required application details. Upload the documents specified in the detailed recruitment instructions. Complete the application fee payment if applicable. Review and submit the application before 22 November 2026. Save the submitted application details for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under AEES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Atomic Energy Education Society has announced 254 vacancies across teaching, librarian and administrative positions under Recruitment Notification 01/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AEES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How many PGT vacancies are available in AEES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AEES has announced 27 Post Graduate Teacher vacancies across nine subjects.

faq.question: Q4. How many TGT vacancies are available in AEES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 102 Trained Graduate Teacher vacancies across ten subject categories.

faq.question: Q5. How many Primary Teacher vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: AEES has announced 89 Primary Teacher posts and 10 Primary Teacher (Music) posts, making 99 PRT vacancies in total.

faq.question: Q6. When will the detailed AEES Recruitment 2026 notification be available?
faq.answer: The preliminary advertisement states that detailed information on qualifications, eligibility, application procedures, fees and selection criteria will be available on 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for AEES teaching posts?
faq.answer: The notified posts carry different Central Government pay levels. PGT posts are listed at Level 8, TGT posts at Level 7 and PRT posts at Level 6.

faq.question: Q8. Where can candidates apply for AEES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the official AEES online recruitment portal at aees.onlineregistrationforms.com and follow the published application instructions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of AEES?
faq.answer: Candidates can access official updates, notifications, and application portals by visiting the official website at https://aees.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: This recruitment drive is officially designated under advertisement number 01/2026/RECRUITMENT NOTIFICATION 01/2026 issued by the AEES central office.
